"""Wait for the original paired-parent owner, then score, audit and render once."""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V155-parent-comparison-v2'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json')
guard(plan)
owner=read(root/'status-v1.json')['owner']
postplan={
    'training_plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'), 'expected_controller_owner':owner,
    'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'), ref(root/'reporters-source-v1.json'),ref(root/'renderers-source-v1.json')],
    'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for directory in ['reporters-v1','renderers-v1'] for p in (root/directory).rglob('*.py')},
    'controller_source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Observe original PID/create-time only;no restart. On both zero returns,bind actual fresh822+822 root/DINO results,then CPU scores,independent metrics,native64 rendering. Actual human native viewing still required. No training/noise/parent calls here.'}
assert not (root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json').exists()
save(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json',postplan)
(root/'postprocess.claim').open('x').close()
status={'status':'waiting-on-original-paired-parent-controller',
        'owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},'completed':{}}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
while True:
    current=read(root/'status-v1.json')
    assert current['owner']==owner
    if current['status']=='completed-parent-arrays-awaiting-quality-audit-and-native-viewing':
        assert set(current['completed'])=={'V143','V120'}
        assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in current['completed'].values())
        break
    assert current['status']=='running-fresh-V143-then-fresh-V120',current
    p=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
    assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01 and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
    time.sleep(10)
guard(plan)
guard(postplan)
assert not (root/'quality-design-v1.json').exists()
shutil.copyfile(plan['design']['path'],root/'quality-design-v1.json')
assert ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['sha256']==plan['design']['sha256']
collections={k:ref(root/(k+'-result-v1.json')) for k in ['V143','V120']}
for item in collections.values():
    c=read(item['path'])
    assert c['counts']=={'parent':822,'DINO':822} and c['model_before']==c['model_after']
    assert c['DINO_before']==c['DINO_after'] and c['RNG_unchanged']
save(root/'review-result-v1.json',{
    'status':'completed-both-fresh-parent-collections', 'plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),
    'collections':collections,'new_parent_forwards':1644,'new_DINO_forwards':1644,
    'new_noise_draws':0,'training_updates':0,'controller':ref(root/'status-v1.json')})
for stage,directory,script in [
    ('scores','reporters-v1','score_cleaner_parent.py'),
    ('metric-audit','reporters-v1','audit_cleaner_parent.py'),
    ('render','renderers-v1','render_cleaner_parent.py')]:
    guard(plan)
    guard(postplan)
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env['PYTHONPATH']=str(root/directory/'scripts')+':'+str(root/'work/src')
    env['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']=env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1'
    with (root/('postprocess-'+stage+'-v1.log')).open('x') as log:
        child=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(root/directory/'scripts'/script),str(root)],cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        childowner={'pid':child.pid,'created':psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
        status.update(status='running-'+stage,stage=stage,child_owner=childowner)
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
        code=child.wait()
    status['completed'][stage]={'owner':childowner,'returncode':code}
    if code:
        status['status']='failed-'+stage+'-preserve-evidence'
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
        raise RuntimeError(status['status'])
status['status']='completed-paired-parent-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
print(status['status'],flush=True)

scope: Observe original PID/create-time only;no restart. On both zero returns,bind actual fresh822+822 root/DINO results,then CPU scores,independent metrics,native64 rendering. Actual human native viewing still required. No training/noise/parent calls here.
